system.description:
You touch a weapon an imbue it with your chakra and it begins to float within range and does so for the duration or until you dismiss this jutsu.

When you cast this jutsu you can move the weapon 20 feet an make a melee ninjutsu attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes the 2d8 of the weapon’s damage type.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, on a hit the affected creature must make a Charisma save, gaining 1 rank of Sealed. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, this jutsu has a +1 bonus to its critical threat range and the affected creature makes their saving throw at disadvantage. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, on a critical hit target gains 5 ranks of Sealed on a failed save
